theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_si_signed_coarea
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P) (g : Eucl P → ℝ), Measurable f → Measurable G → Measurable g → Integrable (fun x => ‖G x‖ * g x) (μ.restrict M) → (∀ h : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable h → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, h x ∂ν) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, h x ∂ν) ∂(volume : Measure ℝ) = ∫⁻ x in M, ‖G x‖ₑ * h x ∂μ) → Integrable (fun t : ℝ => ∫ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ, ∫ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' Ioo a b, ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μ = ∫ t in Ioo a b, (∫ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν)
